definitions.explanation: A dry, barren area of land with little or no vegetation, typically covered with sand.

notes:
{砂漠|さばく} refers to a vast, arid region with little rainfall and sparse vegetation. Japan has no true deserts, so this word is mainly encountered in geography, news about foreign countries, and figurative expressions.

COMPOSITION:
{砂|さ} (sand) + {漠|ばく} (vague, vast).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- サハラ{砂漠|さばく}: Sahara Desert
- {砂漠化|さばくか}: desertification
- {砂漠|さばく}の{中|なか}: in the middle of the desert
- {砂漠|さばく}{地帯|ちたい}: desert zone/region

FIGURATIVE USE:
Sometimes used metaphorically to describe emptiness or barrenness: {心|こころ}の{砂漠|さばく} (emotional wasteland), {文化|ぶんか}の{砂漠|さばく} (cultural desert).

CAUTION:
Do not confuse with the verb {裁|さば}く (to judge), which shares the same reading but has different kanji and meaning.
